# Studio Dentistico Marostica

Studio Dentistico Marostica is a dental clinic in Marostica (Vicenza), Italy.

- Name: Studio Dentistico Marostica
- Doctor: Dr. Mourtada, odontoiatra (dentist)
- Address: Via XXIV Maggio 39, 36063 Marostica (VI), Italy
- Phone: +39 351 8228984, +39 0424 73061
- Email: info@studiodentisticomarostica.it
- Languages: Italian, English, French, Arabic
- Hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–19:00; Saturday 09:00–13:00; Sunday closed
